title: Kantan calendar plugin settings
description: The 'config.settings' block of a module running kantan-plugin-calendar. Every setting is optional.

format.description: Format string for the bar display value, or a list of coloured segments.

text.description: The segment's text, a format string.

fg.description: The segment's colour. Left out, it takes the module's.

when.description: The variable that decides whether the segment shows. A leading '!' shows it when the variable is empty.

reveal.description: Whether the segment stays hidden until the pointer is over the module, when its hover's type is 'reveal'.

mode.description: What a click opens: 'compact' lists today's and tomorrow's events, and 'full' shows a month to pick a day from, over that day's events. 'full' needs a click of type popup.

colors.description: Colours of the module's views. All but 'event' and 'calendars' are the full calendar's.

event.description: The colour of events: of the strip beside each and its dot in the month. 'inherit' gives each event the colour its calendar has in the Calendar app.

calendars.description: The colour of each calendar's events, by the calendar's name, in place of 'event'. 'inherit' gives a calendar's events the colour it has in the Calendar app.

today.description: The circle behind today. It starts as the system's accent colour.

selected.description: The circle behind the day picked.

now.description: The badge on an event under way. Left out, it takes the system's accent colour.

now_text.description: The text of the badge on an event under way. Left out, it is white.

navigation.description: The buttons for the months before and after, and Today. Left out, they take the system's accent colour.

action.description: The Calendar button, its icon and its text. Left out, it takes the system's accent colour.

dot.description: The dot under a day with events. Left out, it takes the colour of the day's first event.

upcoming.description: Time window for bar visibility, in minutes, hours or days. The module is hidden unless the next event starts within it or is under way.

calendars.description: The calendars to show: a list of names to include, or an object of names to include or exclude.

icon.description: Icon for the bar module. It takes the place of the module's own icon.

previous.description: Icon for the full calendar's button that shows the month before.

next.description: Icon for the full calendar's button that shows the month after.
